prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pet", "Use your existing account to recover your active pets, or choose a provider to create a new profile.", "Select existing profile or sign up"]
1: ["Master Your Desktop Companion", "Learn quick mouse gestures and tray controls to hide, summon, or talk to your pet anytime.", "Ready to Start"]
2: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is initializing its personality and desktop rendering engine."]
3: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Adopt a ready-made companion instantly or generate a unique custom pet from photos.", "Premade vs Custom Pet Path Options", "Continue to Path"]
4: ["Use single-subject, well-lit photos for accurate pet generation results.", "Tip: Clear photos create the best custom pets!"]
5: ["Sign in with your previous login method to restore existing desktop pets."]
6: ["Your Desktop Companion is Active!", "Follow these quick checks to ensure your pet displays and responds on your desktop.", "Desktop Pet Readiness Checklist"]
7: ["Pick Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Choose a fast instant adoption pet or craft a customized companion tailored for your screen.", "Continue Selection"]
8: ["Select Your Premade Desktop Friend", "These companions are ready to join your desktop immediately without waiting.", "Ready for Instant Desktop Launch"]
9: ["Initializing Desktop Companion Engine", "Configuring desktop screen overlays, animation cycles, and interaction controls."]
